		stroke.Color = v and C.AccentLight or C.Border
		stroke.Transparency = v and 0.15 or 0.4

	bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 4)
	bar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 15)
	bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 28, 50)
	bar.BorderSizePixel = 0

	local barCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	barCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	barCorner.Parent = bar

	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1)
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = C.AccentLight
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.Parent = bar

	local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	fillCorner.Parent = fill

	local dragging = false

	local function SetValue(v)
		v = math.clamp(v, minV, maxV)
		local percent = (v - minV) / (maxV - minV)
		fill.Size = UDim2.new(percent, 0, 1, 0)
		label.Text = text .. ": " .. math.floor(v)
		callback(v)
	end

	local function ProcessInput(input)
		local percent = math.clamp((input.Position.X - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
		SetValue(minV + (maxV - minV) * percent)
	end

	bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			ProcessInput(input)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if not dragging then return end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			ProcessInput(input)
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = false
		end
	end)

	SetValue(value)
	return container

	current.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	current.Text = value
	current.TextColor3 = C.AccentLight
	current.TextSize = 8
	current.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	current.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
	current.Parent = button

	local index = 1
	for i, v in ipairs(options) do
		if v == value then
			index = i
			break
		end
	end

	button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		index += 1
		if index > #options then index = 1 end
		value = options[index]
		current.Text = value
		callback(value)
	end)

	return button
end

local aimSection = CreateSection("AIM ASSIST", 1)
CreateToggle(aimSection, "Enable Aim Assist", Config.AimAssist, function(v) Config.AimAssist = v end)
CreateSlider(aimSection, "FOV", 30, 600, Config.FOV, function(v) Config.FOV = v end)

CreateCycle(aimSection, "Aim Part", { "Head", "UpperTorso", "Torso", "HumanoidRootPart" }, Config.AimPart, function(v) Config.AimPart = v end)

local function GetAimPart(character)
	if not character then return nil end
	return character:FindFirstChild(Config.AimPart) or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function FindTarget()
	local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not Camera then return nil end

	local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	local closest = nil
	local closestDistance = Config.FOV

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if IsEnemy(player) then
			local character = player.Character
			local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local part = GetAimPart(character)

			if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and part then
				local screen, visible = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
				if visible and screen.Z > 0 then
					local distance = (Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) - Vector2.new(mouse.X, mouse.Y)).Magnitude
					if distance < closestDistance then
						closestDistance = distance
						closest = part
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return closest
end

local CurrentTarget = nil

local FOVCircle = Instance.new("Frame")
FOVCircle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
FOVCircle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
FOVCircle.Visible = false

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not Camera then return end

	local mouse = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	FOVCircle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mouse.X, mouse.Y)
	FOVCircle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(Config.FOV * 2, Config.FOV * 2)
	FOVCircle.Visible = Config.AimAssist

	if not Config.AimAssist then
		CurrentTarget = nil
		return
	end

	if not CurrentTarget or not CurrentTarget.Parent then
		CurrentTarget = FindTarget()
	end

	if not CurrentTarget then return end

	local character = CurrentTarget.Parent
	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)

	if not player or not IsEnemy(player) then
		CurrentTarget = nil
		return
	end

	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		CurrentTarget = nil
		return
	end

	local screen, visible = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(CurrentTarget.Position)
	if not visible then
		CurrentTarget = nil
		return
	end

	local distance = (Vector2.new(screen.X, screen.Y) - Vector2.new(mouse.X, mouse.Y)).Magnitude
	if distance > Config.FOV then
		CurrentTarget = FindTarget()
		return
	end

	local desired = CFrame.lookAt(Camera.CFrame.Position, CurrentTarget.Position)
	local alpha = 1 - math.exp(-Config.AimSpeed * dt)

local function MakeDraggable(frame, handle)
	handle = handle or frame

		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local CONFIG_FILE_NAME = "TraitDebuggerConfig.json"

local function saveSettings(data)
	local jsonString = HttpService:JSONEncode(data)
	
	if writefile then
		pcall(function() writefile(CONFIG_FILE_NAME, jsonString) end)
	end
	
	pcall(function()
		TeleportService:SetTeleportSetting("TraitDebuggerConfig", jsonString)
	end)
end

local function loadSettings()
	local rawData = nil
	
	if readfile and isfile and isfile(CONFIG_FILE_NAME) then
		pcall(function() rawData = readfile(CONFIG_FILE_NAME) end)
	end
	
	if not rawData then
		pcall(function() rawData = TeleportService:GetTeleportSetting("TraitDebuggerConfig") end)
	end
	
	if rawData then
		local success, decoded = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(rawData) end)
		if success and type(decoded) == "table" then
			return decoded
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local workbenchEspEnabled = true
local WORKBENCH_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 150)
local WORKBENCH_HL_NAME = "WorkbenchESP"
local leaderboardVisible = true

local function setLeaderboardState(state)
	leaderboardVisible = state
	pcall(function()
		StarterGui:SetCoreGuiEnabled(Enum.CoreGuiType.PlayerList, leaderboardVisible)
	end)
end

local function purgeCustomLeaderboards()
	local playerGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
	if not playerGui then return end
	local commonLeaderboardNames = {"leaderboard", "playerlist", "tabmenu", "scoreboard"}
	for _, ui in ipairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
		local lowerName = string.lower(ui.Name)
		for _, targetName in ipairs(commonLeaderboardNames) do
			if string.find(lowerName, targetName) then
				ui:Destroy()
				break
			end
		end
	end
end

local playerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
playerGui.ChildAdded:Connect(function()
	if not leaderboardVisible then purgeCustomLeaderboards() end
end)

local function clearWorkbenchHighlights()
	for _, desc in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("Highlight") and desc.Name == WORKBENCH_HL_NAME then
			desc:Destroy()
		end
	end
end

local function applyWorkbenchHighlight(obj)
	if not workbenchEspEnabled then return end
	if obj.Name == "Workbench" and not obj:FindFirstChild(WORKBENCH_HL_NAME) then
		local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
		hl.Name = WORKBENCH_HL_NAME
		hl.Adornee = obj
		hl.FillColor = WORKBENCH_COLOR
		hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		hl.FillTransparency = 0.4
		hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
		hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		hl.Parent = obj
	end
end

local function refreshWorkbenchESP()
	clearWorkbenchHighlights()
	if not workbenchEspEnabled then return end
	for _, desc in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		applyWorkbenchHighlight(desc)
	end
end

Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
	if desc.Name == "Workbench" then
		task.wait(0.1)
		applyWorkbenchHighlight(desc)
	end
end)

local traitCategories = {
	{
		title = "MELEE TRAITS",
		traits = {
			{id = "rustic",   name = "Methodical",          desc = "+15% melee damage"},
			{id = "manic",    name = "Manic",               desc = "+45% heavy swing speed"},
			{id = "boxer",    name = "Aggressive Behavior", desc = "+25% fist damage & faster shove"},
			{id = "violence", name = "Violent Tendencies",  desc = "+45% light swing speed"},
			{id = "honor",    name = "Honourable",          desc = "2x fist damage"}
		}
	},
	{
		title = "GUN TRAITS",
		traits = {
			{id = "recoil",   name = "Professional",        desc = "Reduced sway & -65% recoil"},
			{id = "hip",      name = "Lone Wolf",           desc = "+65% hipfire speed, +50% lever/revolver ROF"},
			{id = "reliab",   name = "Reliable",            desc = "+65% reload speed"},
			{id = "paranoia", name = "Paranoid",            desc = "+50% semi-auto ROF"}
		}
	},
	{
		title = "DEFENSIVE TRAITS",
		traits = {
			{id = "regen",    name = "Survivor",            desc = "+6 HP/min passive regen"}
		}
	},
	{
		title = "UTILITY & MOBILITY",
		traits = {
			{id = "second",   name = "Relentless",          desc = "Increased stamina regen"},
			{id = "leg",      name = "Impatient",           desc = "+15% movement speed"},
			{id = "lungs",    name = "Calm",                desc = "+75 stamina"}
		}
	}
}

local savedTraits = {}
for _, cat in ipairs(traitCategories) do
	for _, traitData in ipairs(cat.traits) do
		savedTraits[traitData.id] = false
	end
end

local savedUiPosition = {XScale = 0, XOffset = 30, YScale = 0.5, YOffset = -255}
local savedUiVisible = true

local loadedConfig = loadSettings()
if loadedConfig then
	if loadedConfig.traits then
		for traitId, state in pairs(loadedConfig.traits) do
			if savedTraits[traitId] ~= nil then
				savedTraits[traitId] = state
			end
		end
	end
	if loadedConfig.workbenchEsp ~= nil then workbenchEspEnabled = loadedConfig.workbenchEsp end
	if loadedConfig.leaderboard ~= nil then leaderboardVisible = loadedConfig.leaderboard end
	if loadedConfig.uiPosition then savedUiPosition = loadedConfig.uiPosition end
	if loadedConfig.uiVisible ~= nil then savedUiVisible = loadedConfig.uiVisible end
end

local function persistCurrentState(mainFrame)
	local pos = mainFrame and mainFrame.Position or UDim2.new(savedUiPosition.XScale, savedUiPosition.XOffset, savedUiPosition.YScale, savedUiPosition.YOffset)
	local isVis = mainFrame and mainFrame.Visible or savedUiVisible

	saveSettings({
		traits = savedTraits,
		workbenchEsp = workbenchEspEnabled,
		leaderboard = leaderboardVisible,
		uiPosition = {
			XScale = pos.X.Scale,
			XOffset = pos.X.Offset,
			YScale = pos.Y.Scale,
			YOffset = pos.Y.Offset
		},
		uiVisible = isVis
	})
end

local function getPlayerCharacterModel()
	local activePlayers = Workspace:FindFirstChild("activePlayers")
	if not activePlayers then return nil end
	return activePlayers:FindFirstChild(LocalPlayer.Name)
end

local function getPerksFolder()
	local char = getPlayerCharacterModel()
	if not char then return nil end
	local perksFolder = char:FindFirstChild("perks")
	if not perksFolder then
		perksFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
		perksFolder.Name = "perks"
		perksFolder.Parent = char
	end
